catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class starts a magnetic stirrer: a catalogue search for stir, rpm and agitation returns no stirring capability, cap.fluid.mix.v1 is experimental and lists well resources, and cap.motion.stop.v1 is for motion kinds. The extension carries an inline one-field input schema (stirring_speed in /min).
catalogue_requests.summary: Start the IKA plate's magnetic stirrer at a speed; the speed becomes the stirring setpoint the plate then holds.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class stops a hotplate and stirrer together: cap.motion.stop.v1 lists robot.arm, robot.mobile_base and motion.axis only, and cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 requires target_temperature, so it cannot be the empty safe-state action this R2 driver needs. The extension takes no input and is the safe-state action.
catalogue_requests.summary: Stop heating and stirring and reset both setpoints to zero with the native stop methods.

notes:
Passed the fake-backend acceptance gate (G1-G9, no warnings; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The digest above is from the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not a package input. The package binds one of the card's five entry symbols, Minerva.Hardware.Hotplates.IkaHotplate:RCTDigital5 (IkaHotplate.py:45), through a direct decorated Driver over the upstream object. NOT COVERED: the other four entry symbols of this repository (ESP32Camera:Camera, MolecularDevices:SpectraMaxM3, Centrifuges.Herolab:RobotCen and Sonicators.Bandelin:SonorexDigitecHRC) are not bound by this single-device package; the upstream heat() task-scheduler method, the standalone start/stop heating and stirring helpers beyond the exposed stop safe-state action, the watchdog modes, the operating-mode commands and the watchdog safety-limit setters are not exposed; the camera image, plate-reader data and centrifuge/sonicator interfaces are not represented. The hardware path in native.py was not run and no hardware was attached. The fake is an in-memory stand-in for the upstream RCTDigital5 object, not a recording of the plate; its starting values and reset values are test data marked '# placeholder' and are not facts. The fake does not reproduce the serial transport, the CR LF framing, the NAMUR wire commands or the plate's rounding. Limits: both setpoint writes, the cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 target and the stirring start speed are Limit.operator_required because no text file of the clone states an absolute temperature or stirring range (IkaHotplate.py:63 only relates the target temperature to the safety temperature, 50 degrees beneath it). site-limits.example.json is an illustrative operator overlay, not a statement about any plate; without an operator overlay every write is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. Safety: the e-stop calls the upstream emergency_stop (IkaHotplate.py:751-765) and the safe-state action x-cap.bamresearch.stop_hotplate.v1 calls stop_heating and stop_stirring, which switch both actuators off and reset both setpoints to zero (IkaHotplate.py:438-457, 480-499). No line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so estop_physical_ref is not set. The package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wP-076) and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null, and the loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package at R2 and R3. No human review and no hardware run are claimed.
